STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast-style meal: one slice of toast, a fried egg, two grilled mushrooms, and a small cup of coffee (espresso-style) on the side. It is on a white paper-lined tray.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white disposable/oval-ish plate, roughly 22 cm across (side-plate size). Area = 3.14 x (11)^2 ≈ 380 cm². The coffee cup is a separate small vessel and is not part of the plated food; I'll count only the plate food (the coffee is listed separately for energy since it is part of the meal).

STEP 3 - Items:
- Toast (one thick slice of bread, toasted)
- Fried egg (sunny-side up)
- Mushrooms (two cooked, grilled/sautéed caps)
- Coffee (black, in a cup; roughly 60 ml liquid, small portion)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate area, ~380 cm²):
- Toast: ~22% ≈ 84 cm² (slice about 15 x 6 cm footprint, partly overlapping plate)
- Egg: ~14% ≈ 53 cm²
- Mushrooms: ~7% ≈ 27 cm²
Total food coverage ≈ 43% of the plate, which is plausible for this light breakfast.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Toast: 84 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 126 ml
- Egg: 53 cm² x 1.2 cm ≈ 64 ml
- Mushrooms: 27 cm² x 2 cm ≈ 54 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Toast: 126 ml x 0.3 (bread-like, toasted, airy) ≈ 38 g. Using the bread-slice guidance, a thick slice of this size is about 40–50 g; I'll use 45 g.
- Egg: 64 ml x 0.95 ≈ 61 g (one large fried egg is typically ~50–60 g).
- Mushrooms: 54 ml x 0.6 ≈ 32 g
- Coffee: ~60 g (liquid, density ~1.0)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Toast (white bread, toasted): 45 g x 290 kcal/100 g ≈ 131 kcal
- Fried egg (cooked in a little oil): 61 g x 200 kcal/100 g ≈ 122 kcal
- Mushrooms (cooked, with a little fat): 32 g x 35 kcal/100 g ≈ 11 kcal
- Coffee (black, espresso-style): 60 g x 2 kcal/100 g ≈ 1 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total food ≈ 45 + 61 + 32 ≈ 138 g plus about 60 g of coffee. Total ≈ 265 kcal. This is a plausible single light breakfast for what is visible, with a moderate toast slice and one egg. Some butter or oil may be present but is not clearly visible, so I have not added it.
